description: LiNaCO₃ crystallizes in the hexagonal P̅6 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.77 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent LiO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent LiO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.49 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are two shorter (2.38 Å) and three longer (2.40 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There are three inequivalent Li sites. In the first Li site, Li is bonded to four O atoms to form LiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent LiO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 1.91-2.03 Å. In the second Li site, Li is bonded to four O atoms to form LiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent LiO₄ tetrahedra and corners with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 1.95-2.07 Å. In the third Li site, Li is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing LiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 1.95-2.05 Å. There are five inequivalent C sites. In the first C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. All C-O bond lengths are 1.30 Å. In the second C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. All C-O bond lengths are 1.30 Å. In the third C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three equivalent O atoms. All C-O bond lengths are 1.30 Å. In the fourth C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three equivalent O atoms. All C-O bond lengths are 1.30 Å. In the fifth C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three equivalent O atoms. All C-O bond lengths are 1.30 Å. There are nine inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Li, and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Li, and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Li, and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Li, and one C atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Li, and one C atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Li, and one C atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Li, and one C atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two Na, two equivalent Li, and one C atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Li, and one C atom.
